RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed. To resolve this, you have the right to file a first-level appeal. You have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to submit this appeal.

Here are the steps you can take:
1. **Contact your doctor:** You may ask your ordering provider to submit a "retrospective authorization request" along with the clinical documentation that supports the medical necessity of the MRI for your migraines. This is often the fastest way to resolve the issue.
2. **File an appeal:** If you choose to appeal directly, please complete form FORM-APP-1. Once submitted, standard appeals are typically processed within 30 calendar days.

Please let us know if you need a copy of the appeal form sent to your address. This ticket is now resolved.
